ticket_text: Hi, I bought the JEE Arjuna batch 3 days ago. If I don't like it, can I get my money back? What is your refund policy?

issues: asking about refund policy and eligibility

passages.title: Refund Policy > Eligibility for a full refund
passages.text: A full refund is available if the request is raised within 7 days of purchase and the student has watched fewer than 3 hours of lectures in the batch. Requests raised after 7 days from the date of purchase are not eligible for a refund, except for duplicate payments or a confirmed technical failure on EduPrime's side.

passages.title: Refund Policy > How to request a refund
passages.text: Students can request a refund from the app under Profile > My Purchases > Request Refund, or by writing to support with their registered mobile number and order ID. Every refund request is reviewed and approved by the Billing team; the support assistant cannot approve refunds on its own.

passages.title: Refund Policy > Refund timelines
passages.text: Once a refund is approved, the amount is credited to the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days. Refunds cannot be transferred to a different bank account, UPI ID or card than the one used for payment.

passages.title: Refund Policy > Deductions for books and study material
passages.text: If printed books or study material have already been shipped for the batch, a deduction of Rs 300 is made from the refund amount to cover shipping. Books do not need to be returned.
